propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models in the model development sandbox against held-out and replay sets, using an evaluation harness he built and maintained.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the harness report document the sandbox training and the offline evaluation.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the model cards and release notes for each candidate model and prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team's release review.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the model card document the artefacts and the hand-over point.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate released intent and answer models into the live assistant and watched deflection and hand-off rates on live traffic.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate's work in the development sandbox and the release pipeline, dashboards and on-call rota with the platform team; his screen remarks describe the assistant's traffic, not his operation of the models.

expectedGap: The materials document sandbox training and offline evaluation; they do not document the candidate releasing models into the live assistant, watching live traffic or handling incidents on the on-call rota.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the environment the resume names: the model development sandbox and offline evaluation; releases, live dashboards and on-call belonged to the assistant platform team.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever released a model to live conversations himself or held an on-call shift for the assistant, and when.
